news.title: Sushi Core: module menu
news.text: Press Right Shift in game to open the Sushi menu. Turn modules on or off, set their scale and background, and drag HUD elements into place.

news.title: Pick an FPS preset
news.text: Max FPS trades visuals for speed. Balanced keeps shadows and particles.

news.title: Coming next
news.text: Cosmetics, a real news feed and friends are planned. Android comes after Windows feedback.
